summary: Wisconsin Electric Power Company filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of two series of debentures due 20XX. The filing details the proposed terms, including aggregate principal amounts, interest rates, maturities, redemption provisions, underwriting discounts, and the intended use of proceeds. The debentures are unsecured and unsubordinated, ranking equally with other unsecured debt. The offering is underwritten by a syndicate led by J.P. Morgan and KeyBanc Capital Markets. No listing on any exchange is planned. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no special-situation characteristics such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
